summary: Iteration 2 backend testing for Moutoun API: validated 8 preloaded moutoun (incl. 3 new: Sittah Ousoul, Oumdat al-Ahkam, Adhkar wa Adab), 42 hadiths in Arba'in, full Programs feature (CRUD + validations + 5-active limit + schedule enrichment). All 22/22 tests passed.

minor.issue: No validation that matn id casing matches; works because IDs are lowercase by convention. Minor.
matn_ids are not validated against existing moutoun in DB. A program can be created with non-existent matn_ids, leading to empty schedule. Consider validating that all matn_ids exist.
status param accepts 'completed' but logic does not auto-mark programs completed when end_date is reached.

action_items: Optional: validate matn_ids exist in DB on POST /api/programs (return 400 if any unknown).
Optional: auto-transition program.status -> 'completed' when today > end_date in list/detail endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside ai_chat exception handler (line 508) but defined later (line 744). If an AI chat error occurs before module-level logger initialization completes, this works due to module load order; still, define logger at top of file to be safe.
create_program does not validate matn_ids against DB; schedule will silently skip unknown ids. Add a check: count must equal len(matn_ids).

_flatten_program_schedule rebuilds the schedule on every call to /programs/today (potentially expensive for many active programs). Consider caching schedule on the program document or computing only the needed day.
MAX_ACTIVE_PROGRAMS=5 hardcoded; consider env var for flexibility.
ProgramCreate has no validators on duration_days/daily_new_count; current 400 raises happen in handler, which is fine, but Pydantic Field constraints would be cleaner (Field(ge=1, le=365)).
PATCH endpoint uses query params for status; documentation/openapi clearer with body param. Acceptable per spec.
seed_data_creation: Tests create programs under unique device_ids 'prog_test_v2_<testname>' and clean up via fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 22 backend tests pass. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers moutoun preload (8 incl. 3 new), Arba'in 42 hadiths, programs CRUD with all validations (empty matn_ids, duration/daily_new bounds, 5-active limit, patch reactivation rejection, delete 404, today endpoint filtering by active status, _id never exposed). Cleanup fixture removes programs after each test. AI chat skipped (validated previously). Frontend skipped per request.
